data.title: Charles Hoskinson Says He Never Promised ADA Price Gains Amid Holder Anger
data.description:
Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson said he never promised ADA price gains during a heated livestream with frustrated holders, disputing a viewer’s claim that he had promised Cardano would overtake Bitcoin. The exchange and Cardano’s completed roadmap were reported by BeInCrypto, as ADA traded near $0.1635, down 26.6% over the past month and about 94.7% below its $3.09 all-time high reached in September 2021.

Hoskinson said the five-era roadmap is complete and that his work on Cardano is done, adding that the network has millions of users, governs itself and no longer depends on him. The roadmap covered Byron (2017 network launch), Shelley (2020 staking), Goguen (2021 smart contracts), Basho (2022 scaling) and Voltaire (2024 on-chain governance). The Plomin hard fork in January 2025 gave ADA holders direct voting power over the network’s future. Hoskinson said he had expressed a belief that Cardano could become the largest cryptocurrency, but had not promised that outcome or price appreciation.

data.title: Strategy Proposes $10 Billion to $30 Billion in Digital Credit Financing Capacity
data.description:
Strategy Executive Chairman Michael Saylor proposed creating $10 billion to $30 billion in digital credit financing capacity from the company’s existing balance sheet during its third-quarter earnings call, without issuing common stock or relying on further Bitcoin price gains. According to Odaily, the $30 billion figure is the capacity ceiling, not a near-term fundraising target.

CEO Phong Le said future Bitcoin purchases will mainly be funded by issuing preferred securities, particularly STRC perpetual preferred stock. The securities have no fixed maturity or voting rights, pay fixed dividends and rank ahead of common stock in payment priority; STRC is designed to offer a double-digit yield.

As of October 25, 2026, Strategy held 848,517 Bitcoin, up 26% year to date. Its dollar assets totaled about $5.07 billion, enough to cover preferred dividends and debt interest for about 3.4 years. The company reported third-quarter net income of $19.53 billion, mainly from $20.91 billion in digital asset gains.

Strategy has $16 billion in nominal digital credit securities across 10 listed instruments. It divides its capital structure into digital capital (Bitcoin), digital equity (common stock) and digital credit (preferred instruments), and is reducing its reliance on at-the-market stock offerings and convertible bonds.

data.title: Solana Confidential Compute Opens Beta on Devnet; Mainnet Release Date Unannounced
data.description:
Solana Confidential Compute is in beta on Solana devnet, and no mainnet release date has been announced. According to Odaily, the Solana Foundation said the open-source tool, developed with the Nito team, includes an SDK and an on-chain verifier for building private AI applications and verifying computing hardware; it has not been audited.

A confidential virtual machine generates a signing key, which a hardware report binds to a recent Solana slot. After verification, an on-chain program records the key, hardware type and expiration time. AI computation takes place off-chain, and the output is signed with the key. Applications can verify the signature and query the on-chain record; conversation content and private inputs are not made public.

The beta supports Intel TDX and AMD SEV-SNP hardware attestations, while Nvidia GPU attestation remains in development. In the Solana Confidential Chat example, the browser verifies the environment before encrypting a prompt, and does not send it if verification fails. The application server can see visitors’ IP addresses, while Nito can see account and model details, request times and ciphertext sizes. Nito has integrated the tool into its private AI platform.

data.title: Poppi Founders Allison and Stephen Ellsworth Start Jetty After Building Nearly $2 Billion Brand
data.description:
Poppi founders Allison and Stephen Ellsworth are starting over with Jetty, a new hydration brand, after building a nearly $2 billion beverage brand from a farmers market business, according to Bloomberg.

Speaking with Bloomberg This Weekend hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, the couple discussed lessons from their decade-long journey, including social media, hiring and team building.

data.title: Polkadot to Allow DOT Locking to Mint dotUSD
data.description: Polkadot plans to let users lock DOT in collateral vaults to mint dotUSD in a later phase. According to Odaily, the mechanism will follow the Liquity model and include oracles, a stability pool and liquidation mechanisms.

data.title: ETF Experts Say Nvidia Turmoil and Democratic Congress Could Reshape AI Trade
data.description: According to CNBC, ETF experts said Nvidia’s turmoil and a Democratic-controlled Congress could redirect the AI trade toward other Big Tech and chip companies. Dan Ives estimated that 10% to 15%-20% of planned data centers could fail to materialize, while demand for compute still exceeded supply four to one. Yorkville Ives lowered its Nvidia price target to $225 from $300 and maintained a buy rating; Nvidia ended the week at $162.85. AMD rose close to 13% for the week, Broadcom posted similar gains, and the Nasdaq had its best week since August.

data.title: Kazakhstan Plans Tokenized Government Bond Issuance in Q1 2027
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Kazakhstan’s central bank plans to work with the Ministry of Finance to issue tokenized government bonds in Q1 2027. Kazakhstan has previously sold about $22.3 million in tokenized central bank bills.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Peter Mattis: China’s Intelligence Can Target Tech Through Business and Personal Ties
data.description: Former CIA counterintelligence analyst Peter Mattis said China’s Ministry of State Security can use business and personal relationships to gather intelligence and potentially influence decisions in strategically important industries, Bloomberg reported. Mattis said technology executives can be targets even without access to classified information, and that AI is expanding Chinese intelligence capabilities.

data.title: Jiang Zhuoer Opens 200% Hedge Short at $65,720, Says Overall Position Is Flat
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Lebit Mining Pool founder Jiang Zhuoer said he opened a hedge short equal to 200% of his position at a Bitcoin price of $65,720, citing weak market performance. He plans to exit and wait, and would close the short at its entry price if Bitcoin rises back to that level. Jiang said the short hedges his 100% ETH spot position and 100% BTC long position. Excluding small-cap DeFi tokens, his overall position is now equivalent to being flat.

data.title: Solana Labs Launches Leap App for 24/7 Trading in Tokenized Stocks and Other Assets
data.description: Solana Labs has launched Leap, a trading app supporting 24/7 trading in tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, currencies and cryptocurrencies. According to Odaily, Solana said in a post on X that Leap General Manager Chris Osborn (@aliquotchris) will attend Breakpoint.

data.title: Paraguay Scandal and Corruption Charges Test Its Safe-Haven Appeal
data.description: Paraguay’s president has fallen, its central bank is in disarray and a financial firm is in ruins, prompting investors to question whether the country remains a good bet, according to Bloomberg. The country had attracted investors in recent years with strong growth, low taxes and a safe-haven reputation in a volatile region.

data.title: STOCKS | Musk’s Tesla Merger Pitch Revives SpaceX’s S&P 500 Bid
data.description: Elon Musk has pitched merging SpaceX with Tesla Inc. as a possible route for SpaceX to join the S&P 500 Index, months after SpaceX was denied swift entry, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Elon Musk Again Praises Jensen Huang, Saying Nvidia Would Have Fewer Deals Without Him
data.description: Elon Musk said Jensen Huang has done an excellent job managing Nvidia’s supply chain. According to Odaily, Musk said many partnership deals were reached with Huang through a handshake rather than a formal written contract, and that at least some key deals might have been lost without him.

data.title: Heating Oil Prices Rise 59% From Last Winter; Maine Nonprofit Says Spike Is Crushing Residents
data.description: According to CNBC, the national average price of heating oil reached about $5.91 a gallon as of Nov. 9, up $2.19, or 59%, from a year earlier. In Maine, the average was about $5.83 a gallon, up $2.49, or 75%; about half of the state’s homes use the fuel. Jason Parent, CEO of AVEC Community Action, said the price jump was putting households under severe strain, with some facing empty fuel tanks or relying on unsafe heating sources. The U.S. Energy Information Administration forecast that households using heating oil would spend an average of $2,115 from November through March, about 21% more than last year. The Trump administration said it would release 300,000 barrels from the Northeast Home Heating Oil Reserve.

data.title: Crypto Liquidations Hit $186 Million in One Hour, Including $60.9795 Million in ETH
data.description: Crypto liquidations totaled $186 million in the past hour, including $60.9795 million in ETH liquidations. According to Odaily, citing Coinglass data, long positions accounted for $181 million and short positions for $5.4592 million. BTC liquidations totaled $54.6108 million.

data.title: Boston Fed President Susan M. Collins: Good Reasons to Hold Rates Steady at October FOMC Meeting
data.description: According to Jin10, Boston Fed President Susan M. Collins said there were good reasons to keep interest rates unchanged at the October FOMC meeting.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Bessent and Lutnick Reportedly Differ on Nvidia Chip Curbs for China
data.description: Bloomberg reported that Axios AI policy reporter Maria Curi described tensions in the Trump administration over efforts to restrict advanced Nvidia chips from reaching China and scrutiny of Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s handling of Megaspeed. Curi discussed reported disagreements between Lutnick and other senior officials, including Scott Bessent, and national security questions surrounding US technology exports to China.

data.title: Kava Pauses Axelar Cross-Chain Bridge
data.description: Kava has paused the Axelar cross-chain bridge as a precaution. According to Odaily, Kava said it would share a full incident report as soon as it is ready.
